answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a bonded identity registry on the willow chain, re-audited by a public randomness beacon. Each agent locks one stake for a single vote; the beacon picks auditors each epoch, and a cloned identity is slashed, its confiscated bond left as a burnt relic. A thousand fakes therefore need a thousand full stakes: cost grows linearly while each vote is capped, so flooding never pays.
